summary: The run reports separate national ages-22-25 population profiles and employed-young occupation-quintile profiles without assigning exposure to nonworkers. National enrollment falls from 0.2336 pre to 0.2211 post while BA-or-higher rises from 0.2941 to 0.3121; employed-young changes differ across quintiles. These are composition and selection diagnostics, not an age-period-cohort estimate or causal correction.
